source_clause: PRWEL3.) Pressing “Switch Users” on the Welcome popup will take the user to the All Profiles tab of the Profiles section. Pressing on the avatar of the text “Welcome [username]” will take the user to the last known tab in the Profile Section.
leaf_desc_037: PRWEL3.) Pressing “Switch Users” on the Welcome popup will take the user to the All Profiles tab of the Profiles section. Pressing on the avatar of the text “Welcome [username]” will take the user to the last known tab in the Profile Section.
reasoning: 驗證目標：7.3（PRWEL3）—— welcome popup 之兩個入口各自之去向。關鍵情境條件：上次分頁不得為 “All Profiles”。為什麼這樣切：兩個入口為同一句之列舉且去向不同，**併為一條方能在同一組前提下比較兩者**；分立則兩條之 pre-condition 相同而各驗一半。

tcs.tc_title: Welcome popup links to All Profiles or the last known tab
tcs.test_item: Welcome popup links to All Profiles or the last known tab
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The welcome popup of the active Profile is displayed
2. The last known tab of the active Profile is the “Edit Profile” tab
3. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press “Switch Users” on the welcome popup
2. Read the screen and check which tab is shown
3. Return to the welcome popup and press the “Welcome [username]” text
4. Read the screen and check which tab is shown
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Profile section is opened
2. The “All Profiles” tab is displayed
3. The Profile section is opened again
4. The “Edit Profile” tab, the last known tab, is displayed
tcs.priority_basis: welcome popup 之兩個導向入口
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: **條文列兩個入口而其去向不同**（Switch Users → All Profiles；avatar 或 Welcome 文字 → 上次分頁），依 §7 兩者皆須走到。上次分頁固定為 “Edit Profile”，**使兩個去向可分辨** ——若上次分頁本就是 All Profiles，兩個入口之結果相同。方括號 `[username]` **逐字引自 7.3**（§11 之 profile-scoped 例外，D-UP22-01）。**與 `SWE1-HMI-PROF-054`／`-055`（6.5／6.6）之關係**：那兩條之 popup 為 ch6 之預設 Welcome popup，本條為 ch7 之welcome popup；037 各自切了 leaf，故各自成條（§8.2.1）。
